scope: Browser layout demo only; no native keyboard, mobile runtime, Agent, audio or business integration.
checks: 54 combinations: 3 screen sizes × 3 body-font scales × 6 states; content, header and composer remain in their own non-overlapping areas.
Draft is preserved when opening a note and returning to the same conversation.
Long note reaches its last paragraph; before/after edit views are actually switchable.
Input and submit work with keyboard placeholder present; message joins the local conversation.
Task stop changes the displayed local task state without removing already available material.
No-blur fallback preserves the same component layout.
No page runtime errors during interaction and captures.
